description: Fetch Analytics and research collaborators assembled smartphone-derived records of visits to Sandton City, Mall of Africa and Fourways Mall in Johannesburg during 2022–2023. The article reports 87,204,056 underlying visits and describes mall destination, travel distance and demographic segments. The current public Mendeley version 5 lists a joined CSV, several mobility and psychographic Excel workbooks, a metropolitan data workbook and an ArcGIS map package. Mendeley states CC BY 4.0, with free access. The deposit is much smaller than 87 million individual visit rows; its exact aggregation level and any origin-location granularity were not checked. Coverage is three malls and smartphone-observed shoppers, not all retail trips or travel modes in Johannesburg. Limitations include phone-sample bias, inferred home and income attributes, and privacy-preserving aggregation. A reviewer-assessed simulation use is estimating retail-destination choice or demand near urban transport nodes. model-sumo is a related mobility simulator, but no origin-destination input conversion was tested. No table, map package or article PDF was downloaded.
